name: AI Support Chatbot → Telegram → Auto-Reply / Escalate

parameters.jsCode:
// Build comprehensive context for the AI agent
const messageData = $('Parse Incoming Message').first().json;
const userData = $('Lookup User in MongoDB').first().json;
const platformStatus = $('Check Platform Status').first().json;

const isKnownUser = !!(userData && userData.user);
const user = userData?.user || {};

const knowledgeBase = `
=== UDARSY FAQ & KNOWLEDGE BASE ===

## What is Udarsy?
Udarsy (دارسي) is a Moroccan educational platform providing curriculum-aligned lessons, exercises, exams, and learning resources for students in Morocco.

## Target Students
- BAC (Baccalaureate) prep students
- Brevet exam students
- Secondary school students across Morocco

## Supported Education Levels
- Primary School (ابتدائي)
- Middle School (إعدادي)
- High School (ثانوي)
- University (جامعي)

## Subscription Plans (MAD - Moroccan Dirham)
- Free: Basic lessons, 10 offline downloads
- Pro (100 MAD/month or 900 MAD/year): Premium lessons, no ads, 100 downloads
- Premium (200 MAD/month or 1900 MAD/year): Full access, unlimited downloads, analytics, priority support

## Key Features
- Curriculum-aligned lessons with PDFs, videos, exercises, and exams
- Progress tracking per lesson
- Real-time chat rooms organized by class/level
- Teacher system with verified profiles and classroom rooms
- Instructor-uploaded courses
- Community contributions hub
- School calendar with events
- News and articles
- Available in Arabic (Darija + MSA), French, and English

## Common Issues & Solutions
- "Can't download lessons": Check your download quota (Free: 10, Pro: 100, Premium: unlimited)
- "Login issues": Try resetting password, or use Google OAuth login
- "Progress not saving": Ensure stable internet connection, progress syncs automatically
- "Can't find my school/level": Contact support to add your institution
- "Payment issues": We accept card payments and bank transfer in MAD

## Contact
- Website: udarsy.app
- Email: support@udarsy.app
- Telegram support bot: @UdarsySupportBot

## Platform Status
Total Users: ${platformStatus?.totalUsers || 'N/A'}
Total Lessons: ${platformStatus?.totalLessons || 'N/A'}
Platform: ${platformStatus ? 'Online' : 'Checking...'}
`;

return [{
  json: {
    ...messageData,
    isKnownUser,
    userProfile: {
      name: user.name || messageData.fullName,
      email: user.email || 'unknown',
      role: user.role || 'unknown',
      subscription: user.subscriptionTier || 'unknown',
      joinDate: user.createdAt || 'unknown'
    },
    knowledgeBase,
    platformOnline: !!platformStatus
  }
}];
